This '''[[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] base''' was located in the Ancient Temple on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] infiltrated it and stole a set of data concerning the [[Radar-cloaking superweapon]].
